name: Google Antigravity CLI (agy)
plans: Google AI Pro / Ultra (also a free consumer tier)
strengths: Frontend/UI work, design checks, second-opinion review. Also reachable as the MCP tool ask_antigravity.
notes: Model ids differ per account: run `agy models` and use an id from the first column. Usage is read from the interactive /usage screen through a pseudo-terminal (~10 s, no model call, cached 15 min); it reports weekly and 5-hour limits per model group, including Claude and GPT models served inside Antigravity, which have their own quota.
